rendered: The solids content of the NMC cathode slurries is given in the caption of the viscosity figure. The NMP-processed slurry (PVDF binder) is 45 wt% solids[1], and the water-processed slurry (PVDF latex with carboxymethylcellulose) is 65 wt% solids[2]. Replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC therefore raises the solids content by 20[3] percentage points, from the NMP slurry to the water slurry.
